vale_house_winter.description: The same Stardew Valley building in winter, like the town's houses in winter: an even layer of white snow covering the roof planes and the top of the chimney ONLY. No icicles. No snow on the walls, beams, windows, sills, signs, doors or plants: everything below the roof's edge stays exactly as it is. Keep the shape and every outline identical.
